description: Get one item belonging to the signed-in person, including notes and tags. Only an item the person owns or has lent out has a current_value. A wishlist item has target_price instead. A gift has recipient, occasion, gift_date and gift_status, and no value: its current_value is always null. The item also has display_value, the per-unit value that totals count: current_value when set, otherwise estimated_value, otherwise null. value_layer says which: confirmed (a value the person typed or accepted), market (a recent sold-listings value they have not accepted), estimate (worked out from the price paid and the purchase date) or none (no value yet).
name: get_item
title: Get item
